name: Pastéis de Belém
description: Baking since 1837 to a closely guarded recipe at Rua de Belém 84–92, near the Jerónimos Monastery.
review_body: Baking since 1837 to a closely guarded recipe at Rua de Belém 84–92, near the Jerónimos Monastery, this bakery is the name food writers reach for when it comes to pastéis de nata.
